info.title: Orchestrator
info.description:
Agentic orchestrator for robot swarm control.

Accepts natural-language prompts, decomposes them into a multi-step plan, routes each step to a specialised agent (Navigation, SwarmCoordinator, RobotInfo, …), and streams live events over WebSocket.

**Key concepts:**
- Every request creates a *task* with a unique `task_id`.
- The plan is built by an LLM planner and executed step-by-step.
- All agent activity (tool calls, mission results, map images) is streamed in real time via `/ws/task/{id}` or polled via `/task/{id}/events`.

get.description: Returns service status, version, environment, and Redis connectivity.

post.description: Accept a natural-language prompt and create a new task. The orchestrator builds an execution plan and starts running it in the background (unless `?run=false` is passed to defer execution). Returns `task_id` immediately — use it to poll status or connect via WebSocket.

202.description: Task accepted and queued for execution.

get.description: Return the current status, prompt, plan, and log of the task.
Return the decomposed execution plan with all steps, assigned agents, and their current statuses: pending | running | completed | failed | canceled.
Return the ordered list of human-readable log messages appended during task execution.

post.description: Request a clean cancellation. All in-progress plan steps are marked `canceled` and execution stops. Returns immediately; transition happens asynchronously.

409.description: Task is in a terminal state and cannot be modified

get.description: Return all stream events with `seq > after_seq`. Use `last_seq` from the response as `after_seq` on the next request to receive only new events. Suitable for long-polling clients that cannot use WebSocket.

post.description: Ingest an event from an external worker or MCP server into a task's stream. Optionally update the task status or a specific plan step. The event is immediately available to WebSocket and polling subscribers.
Trigger execution of a task created with `?run=false` or currently in `pending` state. Execution runs in the background; subscribe to `/ws/task/{id}` or poll `/task/{id}/events` for progress updates.

409.description: Task is in a terminal state and cannot be modified

post.summary: Rebuild and optionally restart the plan
post.description: Discard the current execution plan and build a new one from the original prompt. Pass `?run=true` to immediately start execution after replanning. Useful after transient failures or when external conditions have changed.

seq.title: Seq
seq.description: Assigned sequence number for the ingested event.

status.description: Current task status after applying the event.

StreamEventAck.title: StreamEventAck
StreamEventAck.description: Acknowledgement returned after a successful event ingest.

ts.title: Ts
ts.description: Optional timestamp override (defaults to server time).

status.description: If provided, updates the task status.

plan_step_id.title: Plan Step Id
plan_step_id.description: If provided, updates the status of this plan step.

append_log.title: Append Log
append_log.description: Whether to append the message to the task's human-readable log.

StreamEventIn.title: StreamEventIn
StreamEventIn.description: External event pushed into a task stream by a worker or MCP server.

source.title: Source
source.description: Emitting component: api | planner | agent | agent-sdk | orchestrator.

meta.title: Meta
meta.description: Structured metadata. May include event_type, user_facing, code, images.

StreamEventPayload.title: StreamEventPayload
StreamEventPayload.description: A single streamed event emitted by the orchestrator or an agent.

last_seq.title: Last Seq
last_seq.description: Sequence number of the last returned event. Pass as after_seq on the next poll to receive only new events.

events.title: Events
events.description: Events with seq > after_seq, ordered chronologically.

StreamEventsResponse.title: StreamEventsResponse
StreamEventsResponse.description: Paginated batch of stream events for polling clients.

logs.title: Logs
logs.description: Ordered log messages appended during execution.

TaskLogsResponse.title: TaskLogsResponse
TaskLogsResponse.description: Human-readable log lines collected during task execution.

plan.title: Plan
plan.description: Ordered list of plan steps with agent assignments and statuses.

TaskPlanResponse.title: TaskPlanResponse
TaskPlanResponse.description: Decomposed execution plan for a task.

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: Natural language instruction for the agent layer.

task_id.title: Task Id
task_id.description: Optional externally provided task identifier. If omitted the orchestrator generates one.

session_data.title: Session Data
session_data.description: Opaque session context forwarded from the upstream gateway (e.g. last robot_id, conversation history).

TaskRequest.title: TaskRequest
TaskRequest.description: Incoming request to submit a new task to the orchestrator.

TaskResponse.title: TaskResponse
TaskResponse.description: Minimal task acknowledgement returned after creating or mutating a task.

TaskStatusResponse.title: TaskStatusResponse
TaskStatusResponse.description: Full task info including status, prompt, plan, and logs.

tags.name: Tasks
tags.description: Task lifecycle management: create, run, cancel, replan. A task is a natural-language instruction decomposed into a multi-agent execution plan.

tags.name: Events
tags.description: Stream events emitted by agents and the orchestrator. Use GET for polling or connect via WebSocket (`/ws/task/{id}`) for real-time push.
